item.title: Policy Fellow (m/f/d)
item.description: Project Synopsis: As India becomes an increasingly important partner for Europe in the Indo-Pacific, European expertise on the country remains dispersed across institutions and countries. CEIPE (Community & Expertise on the Indo-Pacific in Europe) aims to bridge these gaps. Led by ECFR and bringing together a network of leading European think tanks, the initiative connects India and Indo-Pacific experts from across Europe to foster a more coordinated European approach to India. Through workshops, conferences, collaborative research, and joint publications, CEIPE seeks to strengthen Europe's knowledge base and enhance its capacity to engage with one of the most consequential strategic partnerships of the coming years. This is a dual role that combines coordinating ECFR’s pan-European think tank network on India with an active intellectual contribution to the project’s work. Within ECFR’s Asia Programme, and working closely with the Project Lead, the post-holder manages the delivery of CEIPI’s activities and events and ensures effective collaboration with central and administrative teams, national offices, partner think tanks, policy fellows, and external stakeholders across the network. At the same time, the post-holder is expected to develop their own analytical voice: producing written outputs under their own name, shaping research questions, and contributing actively to the European debate on India and the wider Indo-Pacific. We are looking for someone early in their policy career who is genuinely excited both to take intellectual ownership of substantive work and to do the hands-on coordination that makes a network project succeed. Develop and pursue research on India, the Indo-Pacific, and related areas relevant to European foreign and security policy, taking intellectual ownership of selected topics within the project. Author written outputs – including commentaries, policy briefs, and research papers – both independently and in collaboration with colleagues across the network, as well as briefings and workshop summaries. Follow and actively contribute to relevant policy debates and developments, representing the project’s work and helping to shape the European conversation on India. Identify research gaps and new opportunities for impactful projects and outputs across the European think tank network. Organize and support project activities, including workshops, conferences in Brussels, study visits, consultations, and related logistics and outreach. Monitor and manage project timelines, milestones, deliverables, and reporting to ensure successful completion and compliance with institutional and funder priorities. Liaise regularly with internal teams, partner think tanks, policy fellows, and external stakeholders, supporting effective communication and smooth collaboration across the network. Track budgets, prepare financial reports, and assist in resource planning and general project administration. Assist in stakeholder mapping and management, and maintain internal systems and databases. Coordinate documentation and administrative duties, such as project proposals, meeting notes, and stakeholder correspondence. Support fundraising efforts, including donor relations, communications, and preparation of fundraising materials. Ensure alignment of project activities with ECFR's annual planning and strategic objectives Additional tasks may be assigned in line with broader ECFR organisational priorities. Education Education and experience equivalent to either a Master's degree with 2 years, or a Bachelor's degree with 4–5 years of relevant work experience A degree in international affairs, political science, public policy, or related field. Experience and knowledge Experience in administrative/project coordination, especially in a research-driven environment such as a think tank, NGO, or research institution. Some experience conducting and publishing research, with a clear ambition to develop an independent analytical voice and contribute to policy debates (this is an early-career role, and we welcome candidates looking to grow into greater intellectual responsibility). Excellent command of English, both written and spoken (native level), is a must; additional languages such as German and Hindi are an advantage. Experience supporting event organisation, briefing notes, and reports is an advantage. Knowledge of budgeting and financial oversight is a strong advantage. Genuine interest in international affairs and demonstrated knowledge of India, the Indo-Pacific, or European foreign and security policy, with the curiosity and initiative to build expertise and views of your own. IT Requirements Highly proficient in Office 365, particularly Excel; good knowledge of presentation packages and collaborative platforms, i.e., Teams, Zoom… Knowledge of handling social media, CRM, data analysis software and research databases and tools. Desirable knowledge in budget management software, i.e., Infor SunSystem and/or project management tools. Familiarity with data protection regulations, basic cybersecurity awareness, and safe handling of sensitive data Strong analysis skills, with the ability to synthesise large volumes of information and find new and original ways of connecting the dots Exceptional writing skills, with the ability to draft reports, briefs, and correspondence to a high standard Highly organised, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and demanding deadlines while ensuring attention to detail Strong problem-solving to approach challenges creatively and proactively, ensuring flexibility to adapt to varying workloads Ability to work independently as well as part of a multi-disciplinary and multi-national team, fostering a positive collaborative culture Excellent interpersonal skills to comfortably interact across various organisational levels and with external stakeholders confidently and professionally Discreet and able to handle sensitive and confidential matters High degree of ownership and self-motivated with curiosity, a can-do attitude, initiative, and willingness to learn and contribute to team success. Special Condition: This role requires frequent travel and willingness to work outside of standard business hours when necessary, including weekends or evenings. Competitive salary according to profile with flexible & hybrid working mode Convenient office location in the heart of Berlin Stimulating and open work culture at an innovative and renowned pan-European think tank with partly hybrid work opportunities that allow flexibility while maintaining productivity and collaboration. Opportunity to collaborate with highly motivated and committed colleagues from diverse backgrounds across Europe, within an organization that holds a distinguished position and wide recognition within the think tank world. If this is of interest, we look forward to receiving your application! Closing Date: 17th July 2026, 17:30 CET We will be reviewing applications on a rolling basis; hence, we encourage candidates to apply at the earliest. Please note that this position is for a fixed term of 2 years. Please use the apply button to submit your cover letter and CV in English (max. 2 pg. and pdf format each document) Candidates must be eligible to work in Germany. Due to the volume of applications we receive, we will only be able to respond to candidates after the application deadline has passed. We appreciate your patience and understanding. We care about your data privacy. item.title: Advocacy Intern (m/f/d)
item.description: We are seeking an enthusiastic, self-motivated, and highly organised Advocacy Intern. Someone who is passionate about European foreign policy and European politics and has an interest in gaining experience in advocacy and campaigning. The Advocacy Intern supports the activities of ECFR’s Central Advocacy Team, which supports the launching of the organisation’s flagship initiatives. The intern will gain insight into the rollout of pan-European advocacy and outreach strategies at an important juncture for Europe’s role in the world. The intern will be involved in all daily tasks of the Central Advocacy Team, helping in the organisation of a range of research, advocacy, and events. They will learn to work in a fast-paced office environment requiring extensive interactions with others. The intern will develop knowledge and skills within a think tank context and in the field of foreign policy and international relations. Assist with the organisation of high-level conferences and meetings for ECFR policy staff. Undertake research tasks to inform the rollout of the advocacy and outreach strategy Assist in the drafting of advocacy documents and briefing notes Assist in the tracking, monitoring and evaluation of the advocacy and outreach strategy Update databases and other contacts to ensure accurate, up-to-date records. Other general responsibilities may be reasonably requested over time. Other general tasks may be reasonably requested over time. Currently enrolled as a (Master's or 3rd-year Bachelor's) student in a related field of study such as International Relations, European Studies, Politics, Journalism, Communications, or equivalent High IT proficiency, MS-Office and social media, as well as Zoom. Knowledge of Canva is a bonus. Excellent written and oral communication in English. German or another European language is an advantage. Creator of compelling visual documents Understanding of EU and governance institutions, especially in the foreign policy realm Understanding of EU international relations and interest in foreign policy. Can-do approach, flexible and able to multitask and prioritize as needed Proactive and high degree of organizational skills Ability to work independently and as part of a multinational, virtual team and to develop effective working relationships Detail-oriented, reliable, and quality-driven Full-time Internship Contract (3 months) with a stipend amounting to 603 EUR/month. Convenient office location in the heart of Berlin Stimulating and open work culture at an innovative and renowned pan-European think tank with partly hybrid work opportunities that allow flexibility while maintaining productivity and collaboration. Opportunity to collaborate with highly motivated and committed colleagues from diverse backgrounds across Europe, within an organization that holds a distinguished position and wide recognition within the think tank world. If this is of interest, we look forward to receiving your application! item.title: Berlin Office & Events Intern (m/f/d)
item.description: The purpose of the internship is to provide practical support for event logistics and general administration in ECFR’s Berlin office. The intern will support events organised by the Berlin office and ECFR programmes in Berlin, including the Berlin Foreign Policy Club, Black Coffee Mornings, lunch events, and the DARE conference in December. The role will focus primarily on logistical preparation, on-site coordination, follow-up administration, and day-to-day office support. Event logistics support: Assist with the practical organisation and delivery of events hosted at ECFR’s Berlin office, including the Berlin Foreign Policy Club, Black Coffee Mornings, lunch events, and other events organised by ECFR programmes in Berlin. Tasks may include preparing guest lists, tracking RSVPs, liaising with participants and service providers, preparing rooms and materials, supporting catering arrangements, welcoming guests, and helping with on-site coordination and follow-up. DARE conference support : Provide logistical and administrative support for the DARE conference in December, including preparation of participant and speaker information, coordination of event materials, assistance with travel and accommodation logistics where needed, support for internal planning lists, and on-site assistance before and during the event. CRM Management: A ssist with maintaining the CRM system and support the network engagement and communication efforts of the Berlin office . Administrative and Office Support: Support the Office Manager and Berlin office team with day-to-day administrative tasks, including answering the phone, responding to emails sent to the general inbox, receiving deliveries, processing or tracking office-related requests, supporting orders for supplies, and assisting with other practical office tasks as needed. Team Collaboration: Work closely with the Office Manager, the Berlin office team, and programme colleagues to ensure smooth event delivery and office operations. Provide flexible support for practical tasks and urgent needs, particularly in the run-up to larger events. Occasional research support: Support ad hoc research-related tasks where needed, such as background searches, short summaries, and preparation of materials for research papers, briefings, or speaking engagements. Other general tasks may be reasonably requested over time. Current Bachelor's (3rd year onwards) or Master's student in Political Science, International Relations, Public Administration , Social Sciences, or a related discipline. Previous experience in event support, hospitality or customer-facing work would be an advantage. Strong interest in international affairs and the work of ECFR, combined with a practical, service-oriented approach for supporting events and office operations. Proficiency in written and spoken English (C1) and German (minimum B1 level) . Organizational Skills: Well-organized, with the ability to multitask effectively, prioritize responsibilities, and maintain attention to detail. Proactivity and Flexibility : Proactive, self-motivated, and flexible, able to work both independently and as part of a multinational team. Communication and Interpersonal Skills: Strong communication skills, with ease in drafting invitations, engaging in social interactions, and presenting ideas. Comfortable working in a multicultural environment and able to adapt communication styles accordingly. Technical Proficiency: Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) and experienced in using tools like CRM systems and WordPress. Reliability and Quality Focus : Detail-oriented, reliable, and committed to delivering high-quality work with a positive attitude. Teamwork and Management: Capable of managing tasks efficiently, prioritizing and multitasking in a fast-paced environment, with strong interpersonal and social skills that contribute to team success.
